mapper.select: SELECT vc.id, vc.video_id AS videoId, vc.user_id AS userId, vc.parent_id AS parentId, vc.content, vc.created_at AS createdAt, u.username, u.nickname, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM video_comment reply WHERE reply.parent_id = vc.id AND reply.status = 1 ) AS replyCount FROM video_comment vc INNER JOIN sys_user u ON vc.user_id = u.id WHERE vc.video_id = #{videoId} AND vc.parent_id = 0 AND vc.status = 1 ORDER BY vc.created_at DESC, vc.id DESC

SELECT vc.id, vc.video_id AS videoId, vc.user_id AS userId, vc.parent_id AS parentId, vc.content, vc.created_at AS createdAt, u.username, u.nickname FROM video_comment vc INNER JOIN sys_user u ON vc.user_id = u.id WHERE vc.video_id = #{videoId} AND vc.parent_id = #{parentId} AND vc.status = 1 ORDER BY vc.created_at ASC, vc.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE video_comment SET status = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{commentId} AND status = 1
UPDATE video_comment SET status = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND status = 1
